title: Burn
description: A blank blue CD-R and your top songs. Drag songs onto the disc and their tracks are mapped out as rings against the 74 minute edge; press Burn and the dye darkens in a spiral from the hub outward under a laser glint, then the disc turns over so you can write the title on it with a marker.
intent: The mix CD as a physical object: the capacity bar is the disc itself, each song is a ring of burned dye whose width follows its length, and the finished disc is yours to label by hand.
sources: herb reference board: fa23 Y2K montage, the spinning CD and hand-written disc
